reference_sql:
SELECT t.country_code, ROUND(SUM(t.n_registered) * 1.0 / SUM(t.n_orders), 4) AS share_registered
FROM (
  -- one row per store with orders
  SELECT s.store_id, s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(o.customer_id) AS n_registered
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_id, s.country_code
) AS t
GROUP BY t.country_code
alternatives:
SELECT s.country_code, ROUND(COUNT(o.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS share_registered
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.country_code

WITH store_counts AS (
  -- one row per store with orders
  SELECT s.store_id, s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(o.customer_id) AS n_registered
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_id, s.country_code
)
SELECT country_code, ROUND(SUM(n_registered) * 1.0 / SUM(n_orders), 4) AS share_registered
FROM store_counts
GROUP BY country_code

other_way.sql:
SELECT s.country_code, ROUND(COUNT(o.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS share_registered
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.country_code
other_way.tradeoff: Counting the registered orders over all orders per country needs no inner step, since the store totals only add up.
